nodes.name: Receive Publish Request
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by 01 with the exported product package.

nodes.name: Factory Config
nodes.notes: แก้ค่าตั้งค่าทั้งหมดที่ DEFAULTS ในโค้ดของ node นี้ (ดับเบิลคลิกเข้ามาแก้ได้เลย) รองรับ n8n Cloud - ไม่ต้องใช้ environment variable. Order: parent cfg > Variables > env > defaults.

nodes.name: Prompt Library
nodes.notes: Versioned prompt for the Publisher agent.

nodes.name: Normalize Publish Input
nodes.notes: Refuses anything that did not pass the QA gate in 03.

nodes.name: Build Publisher Prompt
nodes.notes: Renders the Publisher AI template.

nodes.name: Gemini: Publisher AI
nodes.notes: Agent 8/8. Final policy check plus cross-platform compatibility opinion.

nodes.name: Parse Publisher Verdict
nodes.notes: The listing state comes from configuration, never from the model.

nodes.name: Check: Publisher Approved
nodes.notes: A veto here stops the upload entirely.

nodes.name: Build Etsy Listing Payload
nodes.notes: Clamps every Etsy field again - one bad field rejects the whole call.

nodes.name: Etsy: Create Draft Listing
nodes.notes: Creates the listing as a DRAFT (state comes from ETSY_LISTING_STATE, default draft) so a human reviews before it goes live. OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: Check: Listing Created
nodes.notes: Etsy returns listing_id on success; anything else is a failure.

nodes.name: Enumerate Listing Images
nodes.notes: Cover, previews, then thumbnail - one item per image, ranked.

nodes.name: Loop: Listing Images
nodes.notes: Sequential upload keeps well inside Etsy's rate limits.

nodes.name: Prepare Image Upload
nodes.notes: base64 manifest entry -> n8n binary for the multipart request.

nodes.name: Etsy: Upload Listing Image
nodes.notes: Multipart image upload, one call per image.

nodes.name: Collect Image Uploads
nodes.notes: Summarises the loop and carries the listing id forward.

nodes.name: Prepare Digital File Upload
nodes.notes: The PDF the buyer actually downloads, as binary.

nodes.name: Etsy: Upload Listing File
nodes.notes: Attaches the digital download to the listing.

nodes.name: Check Gumroad Compatibility
nodes.notes: Deterministic rules first; the Publisher agent can only veto.

nodes.name: Check: Gumroad Compatible
nodes.notes: Compatible products get a prepared package - never an automatic upload.

nodes.name: Prepare Gumroad Package
nodes.notes: Builds gumroad-package.json. PREPARE ONLY, no API call to Gumroad.

nodes.name: Skip Gumroad Package
nodes.notes: Records why Gumroad was skipped so the reason is auditable.

nodes.name: Check MiriCanvas Compatibility
nodes.notes: Requires an editable SVG source - a flat PDF is not importable.

nodes.name: Check: MiriCanvas Compatible
nodes.notes: Same rule as Gumroad: prepare only.

nodes.name: Prepare MiriCanvas Package
nodes.notes: Builds miricanvas-package.json. PREPARE ONLY, no upload.

nodes.name: Skip MiriCanvas Package
nodes.notes: Records why MiriCanvas was skipped.

nodes.name: Merge: Package Preparation
nodes.notes: Join point for both compatibility branches.

nodes.name: Build Publish Result
nodes.notes: Publish contract for 01, plus the package files for the Drive backup.

nodes.name: Return: Publish Result
nodes.notes: Terminal node - its item is the sub-workflow return value.

nodes.name: Build Publish Failure
nodes.notes: Turns a veto or an Etsy error into ok=false with a readable reason.
